title: ever FLORENCE|Sequin Round Neckline Dress with Chiffon
descriptionHtml:
This sparkling sequin evening dress features a classic round neckline, half sleeves and a flowy A-line skirt which is friendly to most people. The ribbon in the waist helps to define your curve! We think this stunning long sleeve sequin evening dress is perfect for evening party, cocktail, prom, homecoming, graduation, weddings, and any other formal affair!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded , with Lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises sequin.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
